name: 會議分段共同編輯與組織指定分享
requiresDatabases: Existing project-local meeting workspaces, revisions and central personnel
requiresEnv: Existing project-local LINE, Notion, Drive and task service configuration
installTargets: Original DailyLog task and personnel service
definitionOfDone: Reading and editing share a full-content layout
Current conversation members explicitly save individual paragraphs and tasks before and after publication
Unicode additions/deletions, actor/color/time and complete audit history preserved
Same-part conflicts never silently overwrite and independent parts merge
Published revisions queue in order with durable task/Notion receipts
Host can search the authoritative organization and select multiple recipients
Named recipients can only read published content and audio after current identity/personnel checks
Removing a recipient denies new reads and audio requests
Original data, identities, services, modules, assets and configuration retained
Synthetic browser and actual full Worker/D1 tests pass
